I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

I checked only what Pree can see herself: #central-team (she's a member) and the public shared files. None of them mention Brackenwater, so there's no contract, CRM record or earlier renewal date to compare it with. I told her I'm treating the date as unverified and won't record it as the real one. The way to settle it is to check with whoever owns the account or get the customer to confirm in writing.

No approvals were needed: a renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure.
